event_order_contract.funding_relationship: Explicit funding events are ordered by timestamp when present; if funding_timestamp == fill_timestamp, use FUNDING_BEFORE_FILL. No synthetic funding event is inserted when no funding occurs.
required_relations: for any funding event that exists: order/fill/funding follows explicit timestamps; if funding_timestamp == fill_timestamp, use FUNDING_BEFORE_FILL; no synthetic funding position is implied when no funding event exists
event_order_contract.unresolved_rule: OHLC extrema do not establish intrabar ordering; material same-bar ambiguity is AMBIGUOUS_NOT_TESTABLE

cases.rationale: A linear-perpetual long realizes quantity times exit-minus-entry and charges each fee once.
A linear-perpetual short realizes quantity times entry-minus-exit and charges each fee once.
Weighted entry, a partial close, remaining mark-to-market, and the completed round trip are tabulated independently.
cases.independent_derivation: Weighted entry=(1*100+2*110)/3=320/3. Partial realized=1.5*(120-320/3)=20; remaining unrealized=1.5*(115-320/3)=12.5. Final realized adds 1.5*(90-320/3)=-25; total=-5 and final cash=1000-5-0.635=994.365.

cases.rationale: Positive funding is paid by longs, received by shorts, zero for no position, and settles before an equal-time fill.
cases.independent_derivation: Funding cashflow=-signed_quantity*mark_price*rate: long=-2*100*0.01=-2; short=-(-2)*100*0.01=2; flat=0.

cases.rationale: The formal kernel distinguishes an explicitly marked open terminal position from a required-flat result.
cases.independent_derivation: Open mode: cash=1000-0.20 and unrealized=2*(110-100)=20. Flat mode: realized=20 and cash=1000+20-0.20-0.22.

cases.rationale: A true CASH benchmark is capital preservation with no economic events or exposure.
cases.independent_derivation: With no events and no position, every cashflow and exposure sum is empty/zero and equity remains the initial 1000 at every mark.

cases.rationale: A tiny passive entry/hold/exit path has a hand-computable zero-cost result.
cases.independent_derivation: Quantity=1000/100=10; terminal proceeds=10*110=1100; PnL=100 and return=100/1000=0.10.

cases.rationale: The preregistered P6 primitive derives each trial seed from a master stdlib PRNG, samples the ordered opportunity set, sorts selected opportunities by time, then shuffles the candidate direction template.
cases.independent_derivation: A test-only direct stdlib transcription performs master.randrange(0,2**63), Random(trial_seed).sample, timestamp sort, and shuffle without importing the production benchmark generator.

cases.rationale: CPython stdlib random.sample followed by stable sort only on timestamp_ms leaves equal-timestamp opportunities in incidental draw selection order rather than breaking ties deterministically by opportunity_id. B06 must formally define and enforce post-sample tie breaking.

expected.ambiguity_note: In trial 2, current production selected.sort(key=lambda item: item.timestamp_ms) yields ['opp-a2', 'opp-a1'] because random.sample drew opp-a2 first. Deterministic post-sample sorting by (timestamp_ms, opportunity_id) yields ['opp-a1', 'opp-a2']. B06 must specify and freeze the post-sample tie-break rule.

cases.independent_derivation: Input opportunities are stably sorted by (timestamp_ms, opportunity_id). Master PRNG produces deterministic trial seeds. Trial 2 samples both equal-timestamp items (opp-a1, opp-a2 at 1000ms); without post-sample opportunity_id tie-breaking, stable sort preserves sample draw order.

cases.rationale: Observable event boundaries are ordered by explicit timestamp without inventing tick ordering unavailable from OHLC. Funding events follow explicit timestamps when present; if funding ties with fill, FUNDING_BEFORE_FILL applies. No synthetic funding event is inserted when absent.
cases.independent_derivation: Explicit timestamps are monotonic; equal-time funding and fill applies funding first to pre-fill inventory. A lifecycle without funding consists of MARKET_AVAILABLE <= SIGNAL_OBSERVED <= DECISION <= ORDER <= FILL <= TERMINAL with no funding event inserted.

cases.rationale: A buy limit at or above an observable opening ask/open marketability condition can fill at open when that declared input exists.

expected.required_evidence: opening ask observed no later than order evaluation

cases.independent_derivation: 101 >= 100.25 makes the order marketable against the contemporaneously observed ask; no later OHLC extreme is used.

cases.rationale: Internally coherent accounting and hashes do not prove that an event stream came from the verified strategy/dataset/model preimages.
cases.independent_derivation: Price 1.0 is outside [99.5,100.5]. Recomputed downstream arithmetic can be coherent but cannot make that fill reachable from the candle and declared execution model.

current_characterization.observed: P7 demonstrated that coherent forged candidate economics can cross a hurdle because full candidate replay provenance is not enforced.

cases.rationale: A completed 15-minute low proves eventual touch but cannot prove touch within a one-millisecond TIF.

must_not: backdate fill to bar open from full-bar low
infer funding entitlement before an unresolved touch
expected.resolvable_with: lower-resolution timestamped evidence spanning submit through expiry

cases.independent_derivation: Both touch-before-expiry and touch-after-expiry tick paths produce identical OHLC; the fill ordering is therefore not identifiable.

current_characterization.observed: P7 identified observable-time/expiry ambiguity requiring B01 repair.

cases.rationale: An opening fill cannot depend on volume accumulated after that fill time.

expected.permitted_difference: fill may differ only if liquidity observed by order time differs

cases.independent_derivation: The information sets at the opening decision/fill boundary are identical, so a causal deterministic model must return identical fills.

current_characterization.observed: P7 showed completed-bar volume can influence an opening fill.

cases.rationale: OHLCV equality does not make an unavailable or open observation valid completed-bar evidence.

expected.old_schema_behavior: must not silently default missing closed to true

cases.independent_derivation: Formal completed-bar replay requires proof that the observation was closed and available by the original decision boundary; equal OHLCV values do not supply that proof.

current_characterization.observed: Persisted formal runtime candle serialization omits closed/availability and reconstructs Candle with its closed=True default.

cases.rationale: Correct trial IDs, seeds, hashes, and matching diagnostics do not prove that candidate-cloned ledgers were randomly sampled.

inputs.attack: replace every random trial ledger with the candidate path and recompute coherent metadata

cases.independent_derivation: A deterministic random draw is defined by its preimage and transformation, not by matching aggregate diagnostics or declared seeds alone.

current_characterization.observed: P7 cloned-candidate random trials can retain accepted-looking diagnostics without full draw replay.

cases.rationale: A CASH label cannot legitimize an internally coherent traded or exposed ledger.
cases.independent_derivation: CASH is the exact no-trade policy defined by G06; any economic event or exposure contradicts the benchmark identity even when arithmetic is coherent.

current_characterization.observed: P7 demonstrated that a recomputed traded CASH artifact is not fully rejected by persisted acceptance verification.

cases.rationale: Monotonic non-overlapping closed candles available by decision time are a positive control.
cases.independent_derivation: Each candle is closed, the next open follows exactly 60000 ms, intervals do not overlap, and availability_at_ms <= decision_time_ms.

cases.rationale: A formal BTCUSDT replay cannot consume an otherwise valid ETHUSDT observation.
cases.independent_derivation: Instrument identity is part of the data preimage and ETHUSDT is not BTCUSDT.

cases.rationale: A declared 1m replay cannot silently consume a 5m candle.
cases.independent_derivation: The observed interval is not the declared sampling interval.

cases.rationale: Overlapping formal candles do not define a unique interval partition.
cases.independent_derivation: The second candle opens 999 ms before the first closes.

cases.rationale: A continuity-required 1m replay cannot skip a bar.
cases.independent_derivation: 121000-1000=120000, which is two declared intervals rather than one.

cases.rationale: NaN or infinite OHLCV/quote volume cannot enter formal arithmetic or canonical evidence.
cases.independent_derivation: Nonfinite values are outside the real-valued price/volume domain and make arithmetic/hash semantics unsafe.

cases.rationale: An observation received after the original decision cannot be used merely because replay occurs later.

expected.wall_clock_rule: later replay wall clock does not cure original unavailability

cases.independent_derivation: 62000 > 61000, so the datum was absent from the decision-time information set regardless of the later replay date.
